Shane Gillis is a man who has many titles. Shane Gillis is a comedian, actor, and podcaster known for his stand-up comedy, Matt and Shane’s Secret Podcast, and the Netflix series Tires. He also has a comedy special on Netflix called Beautiful Dogs. His comedy is where he has found the majority of his success. His style of comedy is usually casual and sarcastic. He also sometimes gets controversial. This can be seen when Saturday Night Live dropped him fom its cast only days after hiring him because old podcast clips of Shane resurfaced where he said inappropriate slurs about Chinese people, and mocked the Chinese accent. These clips faced massive criticism from the Asian community. His style of comedy has helped him create a recognizable personality among his audience. His success has also placed him alongside major celebrities and brands. This  includes Bud Light’s Super Bowl commercial. Collaborations like this convey how Gillis’s influence has expanded past stand-up comedy and into mainstream advertising. Gillis often presents himself as an average guy rather than a traditional celebrity. Sports, drinking, and male friendships regularly appear in his comedy. This makes his partnership with Bud Light intriguing because the company is able to use a personality that Gillis's audience already recognizes instead of having him act like a traditional spokesperson. On January 30, 2026, Gillis posted Bud Light's Super Bowl commercial directly to his Instagram with the caption “New Super Bowl commercial @budlight #SBLX #ad.” The commercial features Gillis alongside Post Malone, a popular musical artist, and Peyton Manning, a famous former football player. Gillis posted the commercial directly to his own followers, so the video works as both entertainment and influencer advertising.

Sydney Sweeney is a very controversial celebrity and influencer. She gained her following through acting in popular movies and tv series, such as The Housemaid, Anyone But You, The White Lotus, and much more. She is best known for her breakout role as Cassie Howard in the Emmy Award winning series, Euphoria. She has used her fame to build a following and social media presence to promote products, work with brands, and create and advertise her own line of lingerie and clothing. Although starting as a celebrity, she has also become an influencer. Sydney Sweeney has many sponsorships with top brands such as American Eagle, Armani Beauty, Kérastase, and Laneige. She even has her own clothing line called Syrn. She promotes these brands by posting photos and reels of her using these beauty products and wearing these clothing brands to influence her viewers. Sweeney is known for her appearance and sex appeal, so she typically promotes fashion and makeup. The idea is that viewers who view Sydney Sweeney as beautiful and desirable will want to be this and take her beauty advice to elevate their own appearance as these products elevate hers. However, many aren’t a fan of Sweeney because they claim she sexualizes herself too much and has a large male audience even though she seems to be marketing brands towards women. A lot of people also dislike that she does not discuss her political views publicly, whether she's a Trump supporter or not. Sweeney's controversy demonstrates the tension between what is or isn't an influencer's obligation for their audience.Despite all this controversy, she still has 25.9 million followers on instagram, and her clothing brand continuously sells out quickly. Even with the hate she receives she is still very successful. Some argue the controversies she’s involved in are intentional to keep herself relevant and heavily discussed by the media. This helps her gather a larger audience.
